script: Delivery decides whether a client returns, leaves a review, and refers you to others. Professional habits are simple, and you can start them today. Here is your delivery routine. First, confirm the brief in writing. Write down what you will make, for whom, the deadline, the format and the number of revisions. Second, work in short steps, and share a rough draft early. A draft at half way saves a lot of rework. Third, deliver the final files in a clear format: PNG or PDF for designs, Word or Google Docs for text, and MP4 for video. Fourth, send a short message that says what you delivered, where the files are, and what you need from the client next. Fifth, ask for a review and feedback once the work is accepted. Communication matters too. Reply within one working day, even if your reply is only: received, I will send the draft on Thursday. Keep important decisions in writing, and use the platform's chat or email for anything involving money.
